title: Namaz of Imam al Husain (a)
introduction:
NAMAZ OF IMAM AL-HUSAYN (A.S.)

A four-unit prayer of extraordinary virtue transmitted in honor of Sayyid al-Shuhada Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).

verses.translation: This prayer consists of four units in each of which Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-Tawheed are repeated twenty-five times (ten times in ruku' and prostrations). After the prayer, recite the dua of Imam Husayn (a.s.):
